name: Greg Murphy

items.why: This is an ordinary floor vote and a statement of his legal reasoning about state election law, with no finding of wrongdoing and no conduct tied to any of the criteria, so it is not a controversy.
This was a single deleted social-media reply that was widely criticized, which is a petty moment with no abuse of office or other conduct under the criteria.
This is an unsupported campaign-season opinion about an opponent's health, not conduct in office or a misstatement of his own record, so it does not bear on any criterion.

for_review: Reviewed: Murphy's Jan. 5, 2021 press release (murphy.house.gov) and WRAL's April 2021 report, which quotes the deleted tweet and says he didn't respond to a request for comment. I did not open the House roll call for the Jan. 6-7 Pennsylvania vote. Wikipedia and one KDKA search snippet are the only places I saw his vote, and neither is a roll call. The Biden-dementia claim: I could only read a repost of a News & Observer article, hosted on a partisan site I did not use as a source. The original N&O article (newsobserver.com, article245043195) is unread. The owner-sites search returned nothing about this candidate. I did not look for other conduct (finances, business, foreign ties, contracts) because the searches went to the three items. Nothing at the against or open level surfaced.
